answer: A practical sybil defence is stake-weighted cooldowns tied to independent grading history: a fresh identity may post work immediately but its rewards stay locked until unrelated jurors confirm quality, and every confirmed clone resets rewards for the whole submitting cluster. A farm gains nothing by spawning many ferrous keys, since payouts wait on genuinely separate reviewers; a shared horizon of metadata or a repeated zephyr of phrasing collapses the cluster at settlement. Attacker cost is durable, reputable per-identity work.
